Subject: Redwood Private - VPC & SOC2 discovery — post-call recap

Hi Janelle / Oliver —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the clear context on your compliance requirements and the workload characteristics. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) What we heard
- You need a private deployment (VPC-first) with strict network isolation and audit logging
- SOC 2 Type II and GDPR controls are required for production usage; HIPAA may apply for a subset of transactions
- Primary ask: vendor SSQ, SOC 2 report, and a high-level network/deployment diagram for our security review

2) Next steps (owner / ETA)
- You: share SOC 2 report + initial SSQ answers (Janelle) — requested by 2028-02-17
- Us: kickoff internal security review and confirm any gaps (Marissa + Marcus) — by 2028-02-18
- Joint: schedule 60-min security deep-dive to walk diagrams and encryption/key mgmt — propose 2028-02-22 10:00 PT

Questions for you now: do you have a preferred VPC connectivity pattern (VPC peering, PrivateLink, or customer-managed NAT/proxy)? Also curious if an air-gapped on-prem option is on the table or purely cloud VPC.

I’ll attach our vendor SSQ template and a short checklist for the internal review. If you can send the SOC 2 and any deployment diagrams, we’ll start the gap analysis right away.

Thanks —
Marissa

Thanks for the summary. Attaching the SOC 2 Type II report (2027) and a partially completed SSQ. A few notes up front: 
- We prefer a VPC deployment with PrivateLink for ingest and egress control; peering is also possible if necessary.
- We are evaluating on-prem air-gapped only for regulated EU customers; for the initial pilot US region VPC is fine.
- Key management: we use AWS KMS with customer-managed CMKs in most cases — will include more detail in the SSQ.

Attaching: SOC2-report-2027.pdf; acme-ssq.xlsx (answers in tabs 1–3). Oliver and I are available for the 2/22 deep-dive — 10:00 PT works.

Date: 2028-02-16T11:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 + SSQ from Acme (for triage)

Thanks for the ping — quick notes after skimming the materials: 

1) SOC 2 Type II (2027) — good baseline. Controls look mature for change mgmt and incident response. We still need to verify the scope (does it include the services that will host customer data for this integration?). Please ask Acme to confirm the systems in-scope so we can map controls to our deployment.

2) Key management / encryption at rest — they mentioned AWS KMS w/ CMKs. Need specifics on: 
- Who manages rotation (Acme vs customer vs Redwood)
- Are CMKs limited to the subnet/region or cross-account?
- Does the SSQ provide evidence of envelope encryption and key usage logs?

3) Network connectivity — PrivateLink is preferred from a security posture POV (no routeable peering), but it adds egress/proxy complexity. If they plan to call back into customer-hosted services, peering may be simpler. Need the proposed deployment diagram to advise.

4) Air-gapped on-prem — significant engineering work. If Acme expects a full air-gap for EU customers, we should get that clarified now (scoped to subset vs full cluster). If required, we should scope a dedicated private package (SOW) and estimate 8–12 weeks for delivery plus ops runbook.

Action items I can own: fill initial redlines in the SSQ (I’ll add comments in the spreadsheet), draft a short gap summary for Marissa to send back, and prepare a list of follow-up questions for the 2/22 deep-dive (KMS details, network diagram, logging retention windows). ETA: EOD 2/18.

-marcus
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Marissa

Marissa / team —

Thanks — attaching the high-level deployment diagram and the updated SSQ (I added a KMS appendix). Notes: 
- Diagram (redwood-private-deployment-diagram.pdf) shows PrivateLink for ingestion and a VPC peering option for back-end callbacks.
- KMS: Acme will use customer-managed CMKs in our AWS account; we can provide cross-account grants to Redwood's service principal for encryption/decryption operations. Rotation is performed by Acme ops, with logs forwarded to our central CloudTrail.
- Air-gapped on-prem: for now, we only need that capability for a narrow EU Payments product — not for initial US pilot. If later required, we’ll scope as an SOW.

We confirm 2/22 10:00 PT for the deep-dive — we’ll be on the call and Janelle / I will walk through the diagram.

Oliver
